source_title: India Humiliated Again At Hong Kong Sixes: UAE Chase 95 In Just 26 Balls Without Losing A Wicket
source_excerpt:
India Hong Kong Sixes : India's campaign at the Hong Kong International Sixes 2026 has taken another unwanted turn. After suffering a defeat against Pakistan, the Men in Blue were handed another setback, this time by the United Arab Emirates, who produced a stunning batting display to complete a comfortable victory. The scale of the defeat made it particularly difficult for India to digest. Having been set a target of 95, UAE needed only 4.2 overs to get across the finish line.
More remarkably, the team did not surrender a single wicket during the chase, ending their innings at 97/0.
India had struggled to put together a sufficiently imposing total despite having six overs to bat.
Their innings concluded at 94, leaving the bowlers with a challenging assignment against an opposition capable of scoring quickly in the shortened format.
The Indian bowlers had virtually no room to recover once the UAE openers launched their assault.

The target was wiped out in just 26 deliveries, with the batting pair remaining unbeaten throughout the innings.
UAE's emphatic response meant India were unable to make their total competitive.
Chasing 95 in a six-over contest requires an aggressive approach, but the manner in which the target was reached highlighted the gap between the two sides on the day.
The final score of 97/0 left India with little to show from an outing in which both their batting and bowling units struggled to make an impact.
The loss to UAE followed India's disappointing performance against Pakistan a day earlier.
That much-anticipated clash also ended in a convincing defeat for the Men in Blue, with Pakistan chasing a target of 89 in just 3.5 overs losing 2 wickets.
Two successive losses have now put India's campaign under pressure.
The team will need a significant improvement in its batting execution and bowling discipline if it hopes to recover from this difficult start to the Hong Kong Sixes tournament.
India suffered a comfortable defeat against the United Arab Emirates. They set a target of 95, which UAE successfully chased in just 4.2 overs without losing a single wicket.
India's campaign has started poorly with back-to-back defeats. They lost to Pakistan and then to the UAE, putting their tournament hopes under significant pressure.
India scored 94 against the UAE, setting a target of 95. In the previous match against Pakistan, they set a target of 89.
India needs significant improvement in both its batting execution and bowling discipline. Both units struggled to make an impact in their recent outings.
